chunks: And a group narrated to me from Abu Muhammad Harun ibn Musa al-Talakbari, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Hashimi who said: Narrated to me Abu Musa Isa ibn Ahmad ibn Isa ibn al-Mansur who said: Narrated to me Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Askari from his father Muhammad ibn Ali from his father Ali ibn Musa from his father Musa ibn Ja'far from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father Muhammad ibn Ali from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) said to me: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever desires to meet Allah, Mighty and Glorified be He, in a state of safety and purity, and that the Great Fear should not terrify him, let him befriend you and let your sons befriend him: al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Ali ibn al-Husayn, Muhammad ibn Ali, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, Musa ibn Ja'far, Ali ibn Musa, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan, and then al-Mahdi, who is their seal.

And there will surely be in the last era a group who will befriend you, O Ali. People will hate them. And if they loved them, it would be better for them, if they but knew. They will give preference to you and your sons over their fathers and mothers, brothers and sisters, and over their clans and relatives. May the prayers of Allah be upon them, the best of prayers.
Those people will be gathered beneath the Standard of Praise, their sins will be overlooked and their grades will be raised as a reward for what they used to do.

key_terms.الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ: The Great Fear (of the Day of Judgment)
key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَكَ: They will befriend you / show allegiance to you

ai.seo_question: Who are the Twelve Imams and what is the reward for befriending them according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the prominent Tusi chain, explicitly enumerates the Twelve Imams as the divine intermediaries for attaining safety from the 'Great Terror' (Al-Faz' al-Akbar) on Judgment Day. It introduces the concept of 'Wala' (friendship/loyalty) extending to the progeny, predicting a specific group of devoted followers in the End Times who will be ostracized by the masses yet elevated under the 'Standard of Praise' (Liwa' al-Hamd). This narrative reinforces the Shia doctrine of the infallible Imamate as the sole path to spiritual purification and ultimate salvation.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 100 - Narrated to me a group of our scholars from Abu Muhammad Harun bin Musa Talakbari from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Abdullah Hashimi that: Narrated to me Abu Musa Isa bin Ahmad bin Isa bin Mansur that: Narrated to me Abul Hasan Ali bin Muhammad Askari [Imam Hadi] from his father, Muhammad bin Ali [Imam Jawad] from his father, Ali bin Musa [Imam Ridha] from his father Musa bin Ja’far [Imam Kadhim] from his father Ja’far bin Muhammad [Imam Sadiq] from his father, Muhammad bin Ali [Imam Baqir] from his father, Ali Ibnul Husain [Imam Sajjad] from his father, Husain bin Ali [peace on them all] that Imam Ali (a.s) said:

“Whoever desires to meet Allah, Mighty and Glorified be He, in a state of safety and purity and that the Great Fear should not terrify him, he must befriend you and befriend your sons Hasan, Husain, Ali Ibn Husain, Muhammad Ibn Ali, Ja’far Ibn Muhammad, Musa Ibn Ja’far, Ali Ibn Musa, Muhammad, Ali, Hasan and the Mahdi, who will be their last.

In the last era, there will be a group, who will befriend you, O Ali. People will hate them, although had they loved them (the Shias), it would have been better for them, if they but knew. They (Shias) will give preference to you and your sons over their fathers, mothers, brothers, sisters, relatives and kin, blessings of Allah be on them, the best of blessings.
They will be gathered beneath the Standard of Praise (Liwaul Hamd), their sins will be overlooked and their grades will be raised as a reward of their deeds.
